title: Used to be good, before the constant harassment to buy subscriptions
body:
I used to like Alarmy, but then one day they decided that harassing the user at every single possible step through the app, pushing full screen unnerving and honestly cringe inducing pop-ups to buy an overpriced subscription (for an ALARM CLOCK APP lol, for real ??) was a good idea.

SECOND REVIEW : I’m deleting this app and will never download again. Along the years I saw it becoming worse and worse with what I described above, today is a new low with constant pop-ups for premium, for prizes to win, for partners and data collection authorization with more than thousands of partners and dozens of toggles to disable (without an option to disable all at once) to avoid data being harvested. Shame on the developer and at this point I’d rather use the stock alarm app.

title: Finally got me to wake up consistently
body:
I had heard of these kind of apps ("scanning barcode to wake you up") before, but did not think they would work for me. I've struggled with morning drowsiness for years and had great difficulty getting out of bed.
As of today I'm on a 40 day streak of waking up consistently. The act of having to walk to a other room and putting on the night and getting the barcode item => gets me to use my brain enough to get me past drowsiness.
Highly recommended!
